text:
Maya: quick sync — can we decide scope for the Optimize toolkit wedge? need clear ask for batching/caching/quantization tradeoffs and eval-alert hooks.
Jamal: +1. customers keep asking for prescriptive recs and a simple rollout path.
Sophie: what are hard constraints? p99 latency targets, and an acceptance metric for eval-triggered alerts?
Maya: target p99 <= 200ms for hosted small models, <= 400ms for ded & private in baseline config.
Alex: that baseline assumes no batching right? if we add batch=16 it changes latency curve a lot.
Priya: ROI ask from two pilots: reduce token costs by 25% via quant/batching while keeping ≥95% response-quality on our eval set.
Jamal: propose MVP slice: (1) batching heuristics advisor (rules + telemetry), (2) KV prefix caching guide, (3) one quantization recommendation per model family, (4) eval-triggered alert plumbing.
Sophie: agree but we need launch gates: safety checks for quant (sampled hallucination tests), and rollback for degraded eval scores.
Maya: launch criteria idea: 1) cost savings >=15% on benchmark workload, 2) no drop >3% on top-level eval metric, 3) ops runbook + automated fallback policy in Console.
Alex: technical constraint: autoscaling + batching can interact badly. need an ops checklist: queue depth, max latency per-batch, token-prioritization.
Priya: also include tenant-experience tiers: for enterprise customers we default to conservative batching/quant, for self-serve we enable advisor suggestions.
Jamal: timeline thought: 3-week design spike -> 6-week pilot -> gated beta. customers for pilot: AcmeHealth and ParcelLabs (they already asked).
Sophie: on eval-triggered alerts: we should emit signal types: quality-regression, latency-breach, cost-spike. tie to runbook severity.
Maya: +1. please draft acceptance tests for each signal. runbook should specify canary rollout sizes and auto-fallback triggers.
Alex: I'll mock sample config and a short CLI for toggling advisor recommendations in private deployments.
Priya: will coordinate customer comms and consent for quant in private/pci environments.
DeployBot: deployment queued: infra-checks passed for test-ns-3 — next: feature-flag rollout for advisor-v0.
Maya: next steps: Jamal/Sophie write design doc with concrete heuristics and evaluation plan by end of week. Alex + Priya to pair on ops/runbook. ping me when drafts are ready. :white_check_mark:
